m: añjasā ind. straight on, right, truly, justly
a: aṃjasā adv. (instr. of aṃjas) 1 Straight on. 2 Truly, correctly, accurately, properly, justly, rightly; sākṣād dṛṣṭosi na punarvidmastvāṃ vayamaṃjasā Ku. 6. 22 we do not know you rightly or correctly; vidmahe śaṭha palāyanacchalānyaṃjasā R. 19. 31, na hi kaścitpriyaḥ strīṇāmaṃjasā Subhāṣita; sarvamevāṃjasā vada Ms. 8. 101. 3 Directly (sākṣāt), 4 Soon, quickly, instantly; sa gacchatyaṃjasā sadma śāśvataṃ Ms. 2. 244. Comp. — ayana a. going straight on. — kṛta a. [tṛ. aluk] done rightly or justly.
